label: Conversion factors verified
detail: Every factor was checked against the sources above with exact arithmetic in an independent audit; automated tests hold each one to 1 part in 10<sup>12</sup>.

label: Data checked against the CDA Copper Tube Handbook tables
detail: Every OD, wall and ID value on this page matches the tables (automated test).

label: Table checked against NBS Handbook H28 (1957), Table VII.2
detail: TPI, pitch, OD, E0, E1, L1 and L2 match the handbook (three E1 values corrected to the handbook's figures); the ASME B1.20.1 cross-check was not repeated.

label: Exposure limits checked against NIOSH 98-126 and OSHA 29 CFR 1910.95
detail: Corrected where they differed. The typical source levels and the WHO hospital values were not checked.

label: Checked against BIPM (SI Brochure, ITS-90) and USDA FSIS
detail: Absolute zero, metal melting points and food-safety temperatures; °F/°C pairs recomputed. Comfort ranges and industry STP conventions were not checked.

label: US volumes checked against NIST Handbook 44 (2026) and 21 CFR 101.9
detail: Cups, spoons, fluid ounces, pints, quarts and gallons, and the 240 mL nutrition-labeling cup. Gas marks and the 250 mL metric cup have no official source and were not checked.

label: Checked against IAPWS R7-97(2012) and the U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976
detail: The saturation equation reproduces the official IAPWS verification values; the altitude formula and constants match the 1976 standard.

label: Constants checked against NIST CODATA 2022 and the BIPM SI Brochure
detail: The gas constant and the molar volumes on this page.

label: Checked against NIST Handbook 44 (2026), the UK Weights and Measures Act 1985 and NIST's copy of the Tanaka water-density formula
detail: Unit definitions, the density formula and every number in the tables and answers.

label: Inch definition and examples checked against NIST Handbook 44 (2026)
detail: The height chart and all examples on this page.

label: R-value unit factor checked against NIST SP 811
detail: Only the imperial-to-metric R-value factor. The R-values and ASHRAE/IECC figures were not checked.

label: Checked against the National Weather Service wind chill index
detail: Formula, limits and every cell of the °F chart; frostbite thresholds against NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan.

label: Slope limits checked against the 2010 ADA Standards
detail: Sections 106.5, 403.3 and 405.2, and the grade, angle and ratio math.

label: Declinations checked against NOAA GML solar position equations
detail: All 12 monthly values; the latitude ± 15° tilt rules against an NREL primer. Tracker gains and other percentages were not checked.

label: International ¼-inch rule checked against Michigan and Massachusetts law and the USDA Forest Service Log Scaling Handbook
detail: Formula, Decimal C rounding and four worked examples. The Doyle and Scribner formulas themselves were not checked.

label: Checked against the 2006 International Fuel Gas Code (ICC)
detail: Cr values, pipe inside diameters and the capacity tables (results are kept at or below Table 402.4(2)). The current IFGC edition could not be read.
